parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualitySignalTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.75 indicates structural near-duplication between `QualitySignalTests.recoveryMagnitudeRapidCooling` (line 206) and `QualitySignalTests.recoveryScaleAcceleratesRecovery` (line 223), these are distinct test cases exercising different behavioural scenarios of the quality-signal recovery model. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and reduce diagnostic clarity when individual cases fail. The structural similarity is expected in parameterisable test suites and does not warrant production refactoring.
